deskyard terminal: join a shared terminal session

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] terminal [SESSION]

Joins a shared Bash login shell in /workspace, default main. Browser, CLI and
desktop clients share the same session. Inside an existing native shared
terminal, press Ctrl-B then s and choose the session instead of nesting this
command. Detach with Ctrl-B then D; jobs survive disconnect but end when the
desktop restarts. Session names use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores or
dashes and start with a letter or digit.

Arguments:
  SESSION    string      optional  shared session name; default main

Prints: shared terminal input and output

Examples:
  deskyard -d alice terminal
  deskyard terminal build-2

Where: on the chosen remote (-d NAME); inside a desktop without a remote it acts locally
Exit codes: the command's own exit code; 1 when it couldn't run (connection, token, stopped desktop), 2 usage error
